messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — just wrapped a 30m call with Nimbus Health onboarding team. They loved the model quality but flagged three recurring friction points.
Jordan: Thanks Maya. What are the three?
Maya: 1) Confusing per-route billing for multi-model setups — they got unexpected cost spikes. 2) Example prompts in onboarding guide don't match their clinical vocab so results felt off. 3) Tokenization surprises from long patient notes — truncation happened silently.
Leah: Oof. Number 1 is a renewal risk if we can't explain or mitigate costs. Any numbers from the call?
Maya: They saw a 2.4x jump month-over-month after enabling embeddings+chat on same route. They were on a pilot budget.
Ankit: Can we check whether they were routed to a high-cost GPU by accident? I can pull routing logs.
Ben: I can add a quick audit of model variants used and per-token cost by route. Might have been a fallback to larger variant during spikes.
Jordan: For #2, they offered a sample set of 8 clinical prompts that produced hallucinations. I asked them to upload into the feedback bucket — they said yes and will drop by EOD.
Maya: I posted a short capture template in the thread earlier, but here's a cleaner one we should use for product:
Leah: paste the template pls
Maya: ```
Customer: Nimbus Health
Context: onboarding -> EHR notes ingestion
Severity: High/Medium/Low
Repro steps: short bullet list
Example input: <paste sensitive-snipped>
Observed output: <what they saw>
Expected output: <what they'd expect>
Suggested fix / ask: <feature request or docs change>
Impact: renewal risk / blockers to production / minor
```
Ankit: Nice. Let's ensure customers redact PHI before uploading. Add a reminder.
Maya: Good call — I told them to scrub and they confirmed they'll anonymize.
Leah: Next: prioritization. I propose we triage with three buckets — Urgent (renewal risk, data correctness), Medium (docs/prompts), Low (UX tweaks). Assign a temporary priority label in ProdBoard: "cs-onboard-urgent".
Ben: Engineering bandwidth is tight but tokenization truncation sounds like an infra bug if it's unlogged; that should be urgent to investigate.
Jordan: I'll mark the items in our CS tracker and ping the customer success playbook to link the thread.
Maya: Can someone own coordinating with Legal for any PHI-exposed examples if needed?
Ankit: I'll take Legal triage, loop in security.
Leah: I'll create the ProdBoard card for the three items and link to the uploaded examples once Jordan confirms they're in the bucket. I'll also add an accept criteria row: "no silent truncation; clear cost breakdown doc for multi-model routes; updated prompt examples for clinical vocab".
Ben: For the cost explanation, we can add an in-console breakdown per-route and a short FAQ blurb. I can prototype the FAQ copy.
Jordan: Timeline asks: Nimbus wants an answer before their renewal review in 3 weeks. Can we commit to triage+action plan in 5 business days?
Leah: We can do a triage + mitigation plan in 5 days. Full fixes may take longer. I'll set the triage target and owners.
Maya: Customer happier knowing we're on it — they appreciated the quick response.
cs-bot: Reminder: add thread to CS signals repo with tag #onboarding-costs within 24h.
Ankit: Noted — I'll add legal check and post back.
Ben: I'll start the telemetry query now for routing and tokenization logs, will update here when I have numbers.
Jordan: Thanks all. I'll follow up after I get the uploaded examples and drop the ProdBoard link. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks team, please add any follow-ups in this thread so we have a single source for the customer-facing update.
